title: xwf-2000-world-championship
label: The Red Raven

won.source: The promotion's own 19 April 2000 broadcast (Wednesday Night Live).

how: Defeated Legionnaire in a triple-threat ankle-breaker elimination match also involving Over Fiend (unminted).
note: The first attested reign of this title in this record; the belt's prior history is not attested.

title: xwf-2000-submission-championship
label: The Red Raven

won.source: The promotion's own 19 April 2000 broadcast (Wednesday Night Live).

how: Won alongside the World Championship in the same triple-threat ankle-breaker elimination match, also involving Legionnaire and Over Fiend (unminted).
note: The first attested reign of this title in this record; the belt's prior history is not attested.

title: xwf-2000-extreme-championship
label: Ahala

won.source: The promotion's own 30 April 2000 bi-annual awards ceremony broadcast.

how: Defeated The Jackal in an outdoor buried-alive match, with interference from The Red Raven that cost The Jackal the fall.
note: The first attested reign of this title in this record; the belt's prior history (held entering the match by The Jackal) is not attested.
